findings.claim: Dispatching synapse_doctor off Houdini's main thread is a structural crash path in-Houdini. The doctor's 4 moneta checks call store.get_synapse_memory(); on cold construction that reaches store._resolve_project_path, which calls hou.hipFile.path() and hou.text.expandString() guarded by HOU_AVAILABLE but NOT marshalled. Off-main + hou present (in-Houdini) = a bare off-main hou.* call, which a try/except cannot catch. The live sidecar path was safe only because hou is ABSENT there (the guard skips). Crucible criterion #1: off-thread work never touches hou.* off main — this trades a stall for a crash.
findings.anchor: python/synapse/memory/store.py:975,984 (also add() at :1087,:1096 is off the doctor read path); reached via python/synapse/server/doctor.py _check_moneta_substrate/_consolidation/_vector_recall/_use_real_usd -> get_synapse_memory()
findings.handling: Built the doctor-off-main change (doctor._read_on_main marshalling of its 2 DIRECT hou sites + an off-main-safe dispatch branch in mcp/server.py), then REVERTED both byte-clean after this finding. Closing it safely requires marshalling store._resolve_project_path (core shared memory infra) plus a transitive hou audit (scene_memory.py:124, the embedder path) — disproportionate risk for a problem not reproduced live. Spawned as S1 with this as its blocking constraint.

findings.claim: append (chat_display.append_synapse_message) is NOT incremental — it runs format_synapse_message (four whole-reply regex passes) + insertHtml (O(document) Qt re-layout) on main. finalize (end_stream) is heavier: removeSelectedText over the whole streamed span + a full re-format + re-insert. format_synapse_message imports only html/re/designsystem.tokens — zero Qt, zero hou — so it is safe to run OFF the main thread, leaving only the irreducible insertHtml on main. The blocker is that the grouping state (grouped/ts) is computed at append time in the widget, so the off-main handoff must compute grouping on main, format off-main, insert on main.
findings.handling: Spawned as S2 (needs synapse_panel.py, blocked by W1-HSTRIP).
